Join the Team Building the Future of Logistics

At Zimark, we’re redefining how businesses move and manage goods. Join a team of thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers who are shaping smarter, more connected logistics solutions that make a real impact.

Open Positions

We’re always looking for curious, driven people to join our growing team. Check out our latest openings below.
